mentions.name: Astrotechne
mentions.description: A modern technical astrology workspace with a custom-built ephemeris and calculation stack. It provides cross-platform asteroid calculation software to replace Windows-only and otherwise inaccessible tools, and supports animated chart exploration with a time scrubber, inspired by the now-defunct PlanetWatcher.com.
mentions.problem: Existing asteroid calculation software is largely Windows-only and inaccessible (the best tool requires emailing its creator), and the old PlanetWatcher.com chart animation site is no longer around.
mentions.audience: Astrology practitioners and hobbyists who need cross-platform asteroid calculations and animated chart visualization
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building Astrotechne, a modern technical astrology workspace.
